title: Staging's guard holds again for mailboxes, .env and Amazon's email setup
why: Found in the survey for decisions/0173 (2026-11-19) and confirmed by the session manager: StagingGate::here() was private, so CommsSetup's, Mailboxes' and SesInbound's checks threw, were caught as 'not staging', and the safe-mode guard of decisions/0165 never held there. Staging could have written .env and mailbox passwords; SesInbound threw an Error instead of refusing.
